div.l: With Rosted flesch mylke and wastel bred
But sore wepte sche yf any of hem were dede
Or yf men̄ smot hit with a yerde smertt
And all was conscyens and tender hert
Full semely hur wympull pynched was
Hur nose ful streyght hur yȝen̄ grey as glasse
Her mouth ful smal and þ̉erto softe and rede
But sykerly sche had a fayre forhede
Hit was almost a span̄ brod y trowe
For hardely sche was nought vndergrowe
Full fetys was hur cloke as y was war͗
Of smale corall aboute hur Arme sche bar͗
A peyre of Bedys gaudyed all wᵗith grene
And þer one henge a Broche of gold ful schene
On which þer was writon̄ a crouned A
And after Amor vincit omiā
A noþ̉er nonne with hur had sche
That was hur chapleyn̄ ⁊and p̉erstꝭes thre
¶ A monke þ̉er was a fayr͗ for the maystry
An oute ryder þᵗat loued venery
A manly man̄ to ben an abbot able
Ful many a deynte horse had he in stable
For when̄ he rode men myȝt his brydel here
Gynglynge in a whistelyng wynde as cler͗
And eke as lowde as doth þe chapell belle
There as he was lord a keper of a Selle
The Rewle of seynt Maure or seynt Benet
By cause hit was old and somdele streyte
This monke let such old thyngꝭes passe
And held aft̉er þe newe worldꝰus pase
